item.title: Efficient method to capture CO2 from the atmosphere / Univ of Helsinki
item.description:
📝 One gram of the new compound can absorb 156 milligrams of carbon dioxide. The method developed by Postdoctoral Researcher is based on a compound of superbase and alcohol. Tests done in professor group show that the compound appears promising: one gram of the compound can absorb 156 milligrams of carbon dioxide directly from untreated ambient air.

item.title: When square pixels aren't square
item.description:
📝 The storage aspect ratio (SAR) of a video is the pixel resolution of a raw frame. I wasn’t accounting for the pixel aspect ratio in my code. The display aspect ratio (DAR) is the size of the video as viewed – what happens when you apply the pixel aspect ratio to the stored frames.
🔗 Read more: https://alexwlchan.net/2025/square-pixels/
